hardGateFindings.finding: The controls consistently keep hiring-reader comprehension, collaborator corroboration, applications, interviews, hiring, deployment, legal/privacy approval, and related external outcomes unmeasured. The reader study, solicitation, and follow-through remain planned with explicit receipt state machines that repository edits and LLM judgments cannot advance.

The claimed complete role-control population is incomplete and its negative fixtures do not test the named extraction paths. The Home routing paragraph beginning "New to my work?" produces two semantic units absent from the composition inventory, and person-referential route metadata, OpenGraph prose, and the public resume PDF are outside the role inventory. The fixture checker merely creates a generic semantic unit, compares it with an empty set, and never uses fixture.kind to exercise Home, About, Resume, work-card, metadata, artifact, or MDX extraction. Consequently public role drift can evade the exact-set check.

The bundle distinguishes deterministic validation, separate read-only LLM judgments, orchestration receipts, and external human validation, and it states that repository provenance is auditable process evidence rather than cryptographic proof. The non-print checker reported only the permitted stale prior-run bundle bindings being replaced by this judgment.

The current graph-bound mosaic review covers combination-level affiliation, movement, platform-custody, educational-record, expedition, and private-feedback risks; records minimizations and unresolved risks; withholds relationship graphs and identifying feedback; and explicitly disclaims legal, participant, collaborator, and human privacy approval.

requiredRevisions: Replace the role-occurrence fixture tautology with surface-specific negative tests that pass each fixture through the actual Home, About, Resume, work-card, work-metadata, artifact, and MDX extraction path and assert that the full exact-set checker reports the missing occurrence. The fixture kind must select or verify the tested extractor.

Make the semantic inventory genuinely complete before regenerating its digest. Include the omitted Home routing prose and govern person-referential route metadata, OpenGraph text, shared rendered prose, and the downloadable resume PDF, or define and enforce a separate exact-set control for every intentionally excluded public claim surface.

Reconcile the public resume PDF with the Knowledge Bank and role policy. In particular, attribute, demote, or independently corroborate its unqualified NYC Artist Coalition co-founder/lead wording, KC Town Hall co-founder/co-led/secured wording, Harry J. Epstein "Led" wording, and WOW List "secured adoption" wording; bind each retained assertion to an exact proof or canonical claim and its guardrail.

Regenerate composition counts and budgets, the complete semantic-inventory digest, role occurrences, and public-surface receipts after fixing coverage. Re-run focused checks and fresh independent judgments. Fair Rent's current route-derived count itself is correct at 77 of 84: five artifact-type tags are excluded while three content-bound credit units remain included. Its two third-person action sentences are currently manifested and linked to the relevant canonical claims.
limitations: This is a read-only LLM evaluation of internal controls, not human reader research, collaborator confirmation, an application outcome, interview or hiring evidence, deployment verification, or legal/privacy approval; all such external states remain not-yet-measured.
